questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The new fuel policy will ___ the prices of vegetables.
questions.explanation: 'Affect' is a verb meaning to influence; 'effect' is normally a noun meaning result. Here a verb is needed.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The ___ of the new medicine was visible within two days.
questions.explanation: 'Effect' is the noun meaning result; the article 'The' before the blank signals a noun.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The ___ of the school addressed the assembly on Independence Day.
questions.explanation: 'Principal' means head of an institution (a person); 'principle' means a rule or belief.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Honesty is a guiding ___ of his life.
questions.explanation: 'Principle' is a rule or belief; the singular noun is needed after 'a guiding'.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Ravi bought a notebook and pens from the ___ shop.
questions.explanation: 'Stationery' means writing materials; 'stationary' means not moving.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The train remained ___ at the signal for twenty minutes.
questions.explanation: 'Stationary' (adjective) means not moving; 'stationery' means writing material.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: A glass of lassi is a perfect ___ to a spicy biryani.
questions.explanation: 'Complement' means something that completes or goes well with another; 'compliment' means praise.
questions.shortcut: Complement completes; compliment is praise (i = I like it).

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Her teacher paid her a warm ___ on the project.
questions.explanation: 'Compliment' means an expression of praise.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The city ___ approved the budget for new roads.
questions.explanation: 'Council' is an administrative body; 'counsel' means advice (or to advise); 'consul' is a diplomat.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The lawyer gave the young entrepreneur sound ___ before the deal.
questions.explanation: 'Counsel' means advice; the lawyer gives advice, not a governing body.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The detective tried to ___ the truth from the suspect by gentle questioning.
questions.explanation: 'Elicit' is a verb meaning to draw out; 'illicit' is an adjective meaning illegal.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The police seized a large stock of ___ liquor.
questions.explanation: 'Illicit' (adjective) means unlawful; the blank needs an adjective before 'liquor'.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Be careful not to ___ your wallet in the crowded market.
questions.explanation: 'Lose' is a verb meaning to misplace; 'loose' is an adjective meaning not tight.
questions.shortcut: Loose has a loose extra o.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Of the two proposals, the ___ is cheaper.
questions.explanation: 'Latter' refers to the second of two things just mentioned; 'later' refers to time.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Please ___ that all the windows are closed before you leave.
questions.explanation: 'Ensure' means to make certain; 'insure' means to cover with insurance; 'assure' is said to a person.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Mr Sharma wants to ___ his new car against theft and fire.
questions.explanation: 'Insure' means to arrange financial cover through an insurance policy.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: A/An ___ scientist from ISRO inaugurated the exhibition.
questions.explanation: 'Eminent' means famous and respected; 'imminent' means about to happen.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Dark clouds show that a thunderstorm is ___.
questions.explanation: 'Imminent' means about to happen very soon.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The engineers had to ___ a new method to cut costs.
questions.explanation: 'Devise' is a verb meaning to plan or invent; 'device' is a noun meaning a gadget.
questions.shortcut: Verb has S (devise), noun has C (device).

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: After the thali, we ordered ice cream for ___.
questions.explanation: 'Dessert' (double s) is the sweet course of a meal; 'desert' is dry land or to abandon.
questions.shortcut: Dessert has double s: Sweet Stuff.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The construction ___ was fenced to keep people away.
questions.explanation: 'Site' means a place; 'sight' is vision; 'cite' means to quote.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: I am not sure ___ he will attend the meeting.
questions.explanation: 'Whether' introduces an alternative; 'weather' refers to the climate.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: ___ English, Lakshmi speaks Tamil and Telugu fluently.
questions.explanation: 'Besides' means in addition to; 'beside' means next to.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Candidates ___ door to door for votes before the election.
questions.explanation: 'Canvass' is a verb meaning to solicit votes; 'canvas' is a coarse cloth.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The bus to Madurai leaves on ___ days, that is, every second day.
questions.explanation: 'Alternate' means every second one; 'alternative' means another possible choice.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: In the calendar, Monday ___ Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 'Precede' means to come before; 'proceed' means to go forward.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: She is writing a ___ novel set in the Chola period.
questions.explanation: 'Historical' means connected with history; 'historic' means important enough to be remembered.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Yesterday Meena ___ on the sofa for an hour, reading.
questions.explanation: 'Lie' (to recline) has the past tense 'lay'; 'laid' is the past of 'lay' (to put), which needs an object.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The family has ___ the loss with great courage.
questions.explanation: 'Borne' is the past participle of 'bear' meaning to endure; 'born' relates to birth.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Be ___ while discussing salaries with your colleagues.
questions.explanation: 'Discreet' means careful and tactful; 'discrete' means separate.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: The ___ department handles recruitment and leave.
questions.explanation: 'Personnel' means the staff of an organisation; 'personal' means private.
questions.shortcut: Personnel has double n: staff Numbers.

questions.questionText: Choose the right word: Everyone ___ Mohan has submitted the form.
questions.explanation: 'Except' means excluding; 'accept' means to receive; 'expect' means to anticipate.
